title: How a payment is charged
summary: The controller checks the request. The billing service charges the card and records the result in the ledger.
request: Explain how a payment is charged

steps.title: The controller takes the request
steps.comment: `PaymentController.charge` rejects amounts out of range, then calls the billing service. The response tells the client whether the charge worked.

steps.title: The amount limit
steps.comment: `ChargeRequest.MAX_AMOUNT` is the largest amount, in cents, that the controller accepts.

steps.title: Charge the card and record it
steps.comment: The billing service sends the amount to the payment provider. It records every result in the ledger, also a failed charge.
